messages:
Ada: Heads up — after the 02:00 canary bump we're seeing client-level flipflop between canary and stable for same session. Repro steps in prod-ish env. :confused:
Mike: Details? sticky cookie should win over header-based split right?
Ada: We expected cookie to have precedence. Observed: sometimes header-based split (x-canary) wins, then next request cookie wins, and it oscillates every ~30s.
Jen: Could be KV cache TTL on edge? Or salt rotation? Share policy and curl log.
Ada: policy snippet:
```json
{"split": [{"key": "header:x-canary", "weight": 0.02}, {"key": "cookie:rdw_session", "weight": 0.98}], "guards": ["client_id", "cookie"]}
```
Mike: That guards order looks suspicious — `guards` is supposed to be precedence. @sre-bot did we change precedence semantics? :eyes:
sre-bot: deploy log: router v2.14 rolled last night. change: evaluate guards set as unordered set for performance. (PR #1189)
Nora: omg that's the bug. We used to evaluate guards in precedence order; converting to set made header and cookie compare non-deterministic because hashing picks first match from map iteration.
Ada: Confirmed in staging: re-running with deterministic ordered guards fixes oscillation.
Jen: Minimal patch: treat `guards` as array and iterate in order. I'll open PR to pin API contract and add unit test for sticky session.
Mike: Can we also add a metric for guard-resolution to console (which key resolved) so we can see it in real-time? This would help rollout analysis.
Product: yes please, add a dimension in telemetry: "resolution_key" with values header|cookie|client_id — also surface in rollout traffic breakdown.
Jen: Will do, tagging @Product and @Ada for rollout UX so they can display in traffic breakdown.
Ada: Workaround: rollback router v2.14 or set explicit routing rule to prefer cookie by adding top-level `precedence` field.
Jen: PR #1192 opened with fix + telemetry. Deploy patch to canary now? :hammer: 
deploy-bot: starting canary deploy of router v2.14.1 -> 0.05 traffic
Mike: Monitoring — initial spike in oscillation dropped after v2.14.1 hit canary. I'll follow up with an incident note and add graph for resolution_key.
Ada: Thanks all. Postmortem + docs update incoming.
